[[Po Town]] }}'''A Raid and Po Town''' (Japanese: ''' 突入！！ポータウン！''' ''Charge!! Po Town!'') is the 17th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Hau]] asks if he can join [[Ilima]] and the other [[Trial Captain]]s to meet with [[Team Skull]] at [[Po Town]]. * {{adv|Sun}} realizes that {{pkmn2|Totem}} {{p|Mimikyu}} is angry that he insulted his appearance earlier and apologizes. * Mimikyu joins Sun's team and is nicknamed Penny. * {{adv|Rotom Pokédex|Rotom}} takes a photo of Sun and Penny, successfully completing the [[island challenge|trial]]. * Realizing the [[Mirage Berry]] for {{p|Tapu Bulu}} was left behind on [[Professor Kukui]]'s yacht, Sun uses {{p|Stoutland}} [[Poké Ride|Search]] to look for another one. * [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] spot Sun and decide to have him assist in finding the {{adv|Zygarde}} {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Cores and Cells}}. * After discovering that [[Nebby]] knows about the [[guardian deities]] and Rotom can translate it, Sun decides to ask Nebby directly how to calm the deities down without the need for Mirage Berries. * Nebby is revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Cosmoem}}, which is completely unresponsive. * The Trial Captains and Hau arrive at Po Town, but are accosted by several {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s. * [[Guzma]] appears and, after hearing they only want to talk, agrees to the Captains' demands, but only if they're able to make it to him first. * A {{p|Guzzlord}}, {{p|Pheromosa}}, and {{p|Celesteela}} appear to surround the Captains and Hau. * At the [[Aether House]], Sun counts his money and discovers he only needs ten million yen more to complete his goal. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Cosmoem}} *
